headline: Glass release history with verified release details
changes: Browse Release History in the existing theme-aware glass styling shared with Mosaic's Timeline, including Light, Dark and Black.
Use verified version-specific notes for new Preview and Dev history entries and recover supported historical descriptions.

headline: Reliable release highlights for every Mosaic update
changes: Show release-specific highlights in the Update now dialog, including same-version maintenance builds.
Verify the release-note catalog before every production build and in CI, rejecting missing or generic descriptions.

headline: Clear release details for every Mosaic update
changes: Read release-specific highlights in the update prompt, including same-version maintenance updates.
Validate update descriptions before new Mosaic builds can be delivered.

headline: More reliable task editing with the mobile keyboard
changes: Prevent the Day View screen from turning black when tapping outside an active task editor.
Save a focused task title on the first backdrop tap without unexpectedly closing Day View.

headline: Friends of friends and flexible friend sorting
changes: Choose Latest or Closest to sort My friends by accepted friendship date or recent chats.
Discover eligible friends of friends in Explore and from a friend's page.
Control friends-list browsing and discovery appearance separately; both privacy options start off.

headline: Clearer, safer updates with flexible reminders
changes: Review verified release highlights in a centered update dialog before installing.
Choose Update now or postpone the downloaded update until a later idle session.
See a small pending-update indicator beside Wi-Fi on Home.

headline: Update controls matched to your accent
changes: The Update now button and Home indicator now use the selected accent color.
Improved keyboard focus, reminder clarity and small-screen update dialog spacing.

headline: A clearer, more flexible update experience
changes: Review verified changes in a centered update dialog before applying an update.
See a small Home indicator when a downloaded update is waiting.
Choose Later, next launch, or tomorrow without losing the downloaded update.
